messages.speaker: Professor Chen
messages.text: Eighth protocol. Its genome reconfigures in waves. Visible mutations are only the easiest part to read.

messages.speaker: Professor Chen
messages.text: Some alterations remain internal: reflex, fear tolerance, attachment, capacity to learn.

choices.label: I freeze its current form before it loses coherence.
I model the mutations before choosing what to correct.
I preserve anomalies as long as they give it options.

messages.speaker: Professor Chen
messages.text: We can correct an anomaly, but the correction will also remove a possibility. The perfect creature may be an amputated creature.

choices.label: I correct what could make it dangerous to others.
I correct only what makes it suffer.
I keep a record and let it adapt one more phase.

messages.speaker: Professor Chen
messages.text: Choose the flaw you accept leaving in it. No living organism exits a perfect protocol intact.

choices.label: It will be too protective, but it will hold against danger.
It will be too curious, but it can learn beyond us.
It will be too bonded, but it will not grow up abandoned.
